name: Ten Square Games S.A.
summary: Operating on a global scale, Ten Square Games S.A. specializes in the full lifecycle of digital entertainment, encompassing the development, production, distribution, licensing, and continuous support for computer software, as well as games across PC, console, online, and mobile platforms. The company additionally offers its own online environments for computer games. Its collection of free-to-play titles is made available through social media platforms, an extensive network of partner sites, and major digital marketplaces including Google Play, the App Store, Huawei's platform, and the Microsoft Store. Founded in 2011, Ten Square Games S.A. is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.
